chronology.calibration_rule: Use only the last 183 calendar days of the causal training set; threshold is the 95th percentile of absolute fitted predictions.
chronology.training_rule: For each half-year, include only rows whose decision, next-open entry and complete 24-hour target interval finish before that half-year begins.

decision_rule.rank_promotion: Only a hard-valid positive result may maintain or improve rank. A negative or materially weaker 2026H1 result is recorded immediately and may demote or retire the replica.

execution_data.execution_disclosure: Hourly opens are Bybit-native but are not exact historical BBO/depth or queue replay.
execution_data.funding: V5 public historical funding rates valued with V5 hourly mark-price open at the settlement hour
execution_data.price: V5 public hourly trade-kline open at the hour following the decision

model.interactions: each symbol dummy multiplied by sin/cos hour-of-day and sin/cos hour-of-week
model.target: log(XRP or other symbol open at t+25h / open at t+1h)

policy.cost_accounting: Charge half the round-trip cost on actual marked notional at entry and exit.
policy.entry_threshold: abs(prediction) >= max(1.25 * prior-only q95, 0.75 * round-trip cost)
policy.exit: first hourly decision where signed expected edge is non-positive
policy.funding_accounting: Apply each actual Bybit funding event to fixed position quantity and the Bybit mark-price open. Also report an adverse unsigned-funding stress.
policy.period_end_nav: Value any open position at immediate liquidation cost without creating a strategy exit.
policy.position_sizing: At entry set a fixed XRP base quantity equal to current NAV divided by entry price. Do not rebalance quantity while open.

replication_disclosure: The original local source was not committed. This runner is an independently frozen reconstruction from the durable rule, lineage, result fields and immutable 2023-2025 snapshot. It is not claimed byte-identical. 2026H1 is forward evidence for this exact replica only.

robustness.account_ruin: Report and fail economic promotion if NAV is non-positive at any point.
robustness.winner_removal: Remove ceil(10% of completed base trades) with highest positive account PnL by exact start key before slot competition, then rerun the full account.

scientific_question: Does a frozen independently reconstructed causal Ridge UTC-state XRP route that reproduced the selected 2024-2025 development effect remain profitable during the first untouched 2026H1 interval when execution prices and funding are taken from Bybit?

signal_data.availability: Each completed hourly bar is usable only after the hour closes.
signal_data.missing_data: Reject the run on any expected hourly gap; no imputation.
signal_data.provider: Binance Vision USD-M monthly hourly klines
